about: First draft of the tier 1 copy, kept so retrieval-eval.mjs --copy copy.v1.json reproduces the 'before' numbers. Not for use.

items.name: Button
items.title: Button
items.description: Pressable text button with primary, secondary, ghost and danger variants, loading spinner and icon slot. React Native.

items.name: Card
items.title: Card
items.description: Static container View with raised, sunken or transparent surface and optional padding. React Native.

items.name: KeyValueList
items.title: Key Value List
items.description: Label and value list that goes from one to two columns at a measured width, with empty-value text. React Native.

items.name: DataTable
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Sortable data table on TanStack Table that renders cards below a width threshold, with optional row press. React Native.

items.name: TreeGrid
items.title: Tree Grid
items.description: Tree table with expandable rows, row selection, column reorder and pinned columns, plus a compact layout. React Native.

items.name: DragGrabHandle
items.title: Drag Grab Handle
items.description: Three-bar drag handle, 44 by 44 minimum, reporting start, move, commit and cancel through a pluggable transport. React Native.

items.name: Badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Small text badge with neutral, info, success, danger or accent tone, a status dot and size steps. React Native.

items.name: Banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: Inline status banner with info, success, danger or neutral tone, title, description, action slot and dismiss button. React Native.

items.name: EmptyState
items.title: Empty State
items.description: Empty-list placeholder with heading title, description, icon or illustration, and an action or secondary exit button. React Native.

items.name: ErrorMessage
items.title: Error Message
items.description: Inline error text with a danger glyph, announced as an alert; renders nothing when the message is empty. React Native.

items.name: FieldGroup
items.title: Field Group
items.description: Form layout wrapper with titled sections and footer text, exposed as FieldGroup.Section. React Native.

items.name: PrecisionScrubber
items.title: Precision Scrubber
items.description: Drag-to-scrub number control with fine, normal and coarse modes, detents, preview and commit callbacks. React Native; web forced-colors.

items.name: PropertyInspector
items.title: Property Inspector
items.description: Form built from a field list of number, choice, boolean and text properties, committing one change at a time. React Native.

items.name: office-controls
items.title: Office Controls
items.description: ToolButton with checked and mixed toggle state, plus play, pause, skip, plus and chevron glyphs. React Native; web aria-pressed.

items.name: PanResponderDrag
items.title: Pan Responder Drag
items.description: Single-touch drag transport on React Native PanResponder, no gesture-handler dependency. React Native and web.

items.name: IconButton
items.title: Icon Button
items.description: Icon-only pressable button with five variants and an optional selected toggle state. React Native; web aria-pressed.

items.name: AdaptiveColumns
items.title: Adaptive Columns

items.name: ContentFrame
items.title: Content Frame
items.description: Width-capped container that aligns its content to the start, center or end of the parent. React Native layout.

items.name: List
items.title: List
items.description: Vertical list of rows with title, supporting text, leading and trailing slots; rows with onPress become buttons. React Native.

items.name: CollapsibleDrawer
items.title: Collapsible Drawer

items.name: NavigationRail
items.title: Navigation Rail
items.description: Vertical rail of icon and label destinations with selected state and a collapsed icon-only mode. React Native.

items.name: AnchoredPopover
items.title: Anchored Popover

items.name: CommandPalette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: Searchable command list in a modal, with keyboard selection and an empty-results message. React Native.

items.name: CommandPopover
items.title: Command Popover
items.description: Anchored popover menu of command items, with disabled and danger items. React Native, web and QNX.

items.name: SegmentedControl
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: Single-choice segmented control exposed as a radio group. React Native; arrow-key navigation on web only.

items.name: Select
items.title: Select
items.description: Single-select dropdown with flat or grouped options, hint and error text. React Native; web combobox ARIA; QNX keyboard.

items.name: AdaptiveDock
items.title: Adaptive Dock

items.name: AssetBrowser
items.title: Asset Browser
items.description: Asset list with breadcrumb path, search, sort, single or multiple selection and async open. React Native.

items.name: ContextMenu
items.title: Context Menu

items.name: ContextualToolbar
items.title: Contextual Toolbar

items.name: DocumentTabBar
items.title: Document Tab Bar

items.name: FindReplaceContent
items.title: Find Replace Content
items.description: Find and replace form with match navigation, replace one or all, and async search with abort. React Native.

items.name: FindReplacePopover
items.title: Find Replace Popover
items.description: FindReplaceContent inside an AnchoredPopover, placed by anchor rectangle or trigger. React Native.

items.name: FocusAndA11yLayer

items.name: HistoryPanel
items.title: History Panel

items.name: InspectorPanel
items.title: Inspector Panel

items.name: InspectorSearch
items.title: Inspector Search
items.description: Search field with clear button and live-region match summary for inspector panels. React Native.

items.name: InspectorSection
items.title: Inspector Section

items.name: KeyboardShortcutHUD
items.title: Keyboard Shortcut HUD

items.name: MenuButton
items.title: Menu Button
items.description: Button that opens a command popover menu; ArrowDown opens it on web. React Native; QNX focus return.

items.name: PaneSplitter
items.title: Pane Splitter
items.description: Two-pane splitter, horizontal or vertical, resizable by drag, keys or accessibility actions, fold-aware. React Native and web.

items.name: PresetGallery
items.title: Preset Gallery
items.description: Grid of selectable preset tiles with hover preview, favorites toggle and All or Favorites filter. React Native.

items.name: PropertyRow
items.title: Property Row
items.description: Label and editor row for inspectors, with mixed-value badge, override dot and revert button. React Native.

items.name: RangeSlider
items.title: Range Slider
items.description: Two-thumb slider for a numeric range with step, detents, minimum gap, units and typed endpoints. React Native.

items.name: RibbonTabs
items.title: Ribbon Tabs
items.description: Office-style ribbon of tabs and a command panel of buttons, split buttons and galleries; collapsible. React Native.

items.name: RotaryKnob
items.title: Rotary Knob

items.name: SliderField
items.title: Slider Field
items.description: Single-thumb slider with number field, step, detents, units and reset to default. React Native.

items.name: SplitButton
items.title: Split Button
items.description: Primary action button joined to a dropdown menu of command items. React Native.

items.name: StatusBar
items.title: Status Bar
items.description: Application status bar with zoom steps and menu, units menu, selection summary and activity text. React Native.

items.name: ToastAndProgress
items.title: Toast and Progress
items.description: List of toast notifications and progress jobs with dismiss and action buttons; shows three toasts until expanded. React Native.

items.name: ToolRail
items.title: Tool Rail
items.description: Rail of tool buttons with group flyouts on the left, right or bottom edge and roving keyboard focus. React Native.

items.name: UnitInput
items.title: Unit Input
items.description: Number field that parses and formats typed units from a UnitContext, with unit menu, min, max and arrow stepping. React Native.

items.name: WorkspaceHost
items.title: Workspace Host
items.description: Workspace shell with mode tabs, per-mode dock layouts and Ctrl or Cmd+1..9 shortcuts. React Native; web shortcuts.

items.name: WorkspacePresetSwitcher
items.title: Workspace Preset Switcher

items.name: TabBar
items.title: Tab Bar
items.description: Tab strip with tablist or link-navigation semantics, icons and compact density. React Native; web roving focus.

items.name: TextField
items.title: Text Field
items.description: Labeled TextInput with helper text, error text, start adornment and error border state. React Native.

items.name: NightScope
items.title: Night Scope
items.description: Wrapper that applies a named Uniwind theme scheme to its subtree. React Native and web.

items.name: Toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: Header bar with title, leading slot and actions group in default or compact density; arrow-key focus on web. React Native.

items.name: WindowTitleBar
items.title: Window Title Bar
items.description: Custom window title bar with macOS or Windows close, minimize and zoom controls and an edited marker. React Native.
